items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Concrete evidence: security fleet-doctor is not OK with no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown. Recommendation: keep private-launch and security-sensitive release gates active, do not claim clearance or certification, and continue only the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts.

Retain the existing consolidated security evidence matrix. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns, scope, owner, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependencies and supply chain, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
